description: Test source file for Kubernetes runtime serializer, containing test functions for encoding, decoding, versioning, and error handling of runtime objects.

methods.name: Interpret
methods.description: Interprets JSON or YAML data to extract the GroupVersionKind based on custom keys.

methods.name: FillNoCustom
methods.description: Fills a custom embedded version/kind field with no custom values.

methods.name: GetTestScheme
methods.description: Creates and returns a runtime Scheme with test types registered, along with a codec for version v1.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Runs encoding/decoding tests on a given runtime object, verifying deep equality after round-trip encoding and decoding.

methods.name: TestTypes
methods.description: Runs multiple fuzzing tests on test object types.

methods.name: TestVersionedEncoding
methods.description: Tests encoding objects with different versions and verifies output.

methods.name: TestMultipleNames
methods.description: Tests decoding objects with multiple kind names and encoding output.

methods.name: TestStrictOption
methods.description: Verifies strict and non-strict decoding error handling for duplicate keys.

methods.name: TestConvertTypesWhenDefaultNamesMatch
methods.description: Tests conversion of external to internal types when default names match.

methods.name: TestEncode_Ptr
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of pointer objects.

methods.name: TestBadJSONRejection
methods.description: Ensures invalid JSON objects are rejected appropriately during decoding.

methods.name: GetDirectCodecTestScheme
methods.description: Creates a scheme with test types for direct codec testing.

methods.name: TestDirectCodec
methods.description: Tests direct encoding and decoding with versioned serializers.
